verdict.rationale: The evidence covers installing, updating, and validating the existing canonical skills, plus plugin metadata layout. It never documents a skill-authoring spec, a template, or a meta-skill that guides an agent to create and package a new skill. The `validate.mjs` script and the plugin metadata files are adjacent repo-maintenance tooling, not an end-to-end authoring workflow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can author and package a new skill end to end by following the project's own spec, template, or meta-skill
